text.p: ** BIRTHDAYS **
British naturalist and author of the influential book "THE ORIGIN OF SPECIES", CHARLES DARWIN, was born on this day in 1809.
United States' President ABRAHAM LINCOLN, who was assassinated just a few days after the end of the American Civil War, was also born in 1809.
British novelist and poet GEORGE MEREDITH was born in 1828.

Canadian actor and TV star LORNE GREENE was born in 1915. From 1940 to 1943 he was chief announcer on CBS radio. His national career began in 1959 when he was offered the part of BEN CARTWRIGHT in "Bonanza". The series continued in production until 1973. He then played COMMANDER ADAMA in the series "Battlestar Galactica". LORNE had one hit with the spoken "Ringo" in 1964. He died in 1987.

US keyboard player and pianist RAY MANZAREK, was born in 1935. MANZAREK became the Doors' vocalist after JIM MORRISON's death. The band's hit "Riders On The Storm" became a true rock classic largely because of MANZAREK's keyboard playing. Their only hit without MORRISON was "The Mosquito" (1972). MANZAREK then attempted a solo career.
** EVENTS **
1554 : LADY JANE GREY, Queen of England for just 9 days
in 1553, was beheaded in the Tower of London at the age of 16. Her execution was ordered by her cousin MARY TUDOR.
1831 : Boston inventor J. W. GOODRICH came up with the
rubber galosh.
1851 : Fortune-hunters rushed to Bathurst in New South
Wales, following the discovery of gold by EDWARD HARGRAVES at Summerhill Creek.
1861 : British soccer teams SHEFFIELD and HALLAM played
the first inter-club football match.
1898 : A man from Brighton became the first person in
Britain to die in a car crash.
1912 : China's five-year-old boy Emperor PU YI listened

in a Peking court as his weeping aunt read out his abdication speech. This marked the end of the 267-year rule of the Manchu Qing dynasty and the end of 3000 years of monarchy. The rule had declined over the last 70 years through foreign wars and

sporadic uprisings. The latest nationalist rebellion was lead by DR SUN YAT-SEN, who was made president of the new republic, he then gave up the presidency to General YUAN SHIH-K'AI to avoid further unrest.
1924 : GEORGE GERSHWIN played his "Rhapsody In Blue" for
the first time in public, at a jazz concert in New York.
1929 : The "Jersey Lily" and mistress of EDWARD VIII,
LILLIE LANGTRY, died.
1935 : The airship "MACON" crashed in the United States.
1948 : The ashes of MAHATMA GANDHI were placed in the
holy waters of the Ganges at Allahabad.
1976 : Gay American actor SAL MINEO was found murdered
near his home in Los Angeles.
1981 : Australia withdrew diplomatic recognition of Pol
Pot.
1987: Britain's Health Minister EDWINA CURRIE said "good
Christians won't get AIDS".
1990 : Dr CARMEN LAWRENCE became Premier of Western
Australia, the first woman Premier of an Australian State.
1994 : More than 100 people trekked the 31-mile (50 km)
subterranean Channel Tunnel in a sponsored walk for charity. They became the first humans to walk from France to Britain since the Ice Age.
1996 : YASSER ARAFAT took office as the first Palestinian
president.
